_comment: Guided tours for this site, in the client's language. node tours.mjs validate | check | install | remove. Step type: next | redirect | interactive; interactive_type: submit | text | other | button | checkbox_radio | select. Targets are plain CSS. The optional test object tells test-tours.mjs what to do on a step: fill, select (option label) or choose (fancy-select option text).
